title: Review: jmap-mail-server pass 5 changes
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — no new public surface, all changes narrow existing behavior; the args-to-Map guard is dead code in practice but harmless.
Confidence: 95% chance of no missed bug. Least confident flags: none — the logic changes are mechanical. Uncertainty driven by: MemoryBackend not testing filter behavior of query_objects, so the inMailbox path is not exercised in integration tests.
Idiom rating: CLEAN — no gratuitous clones in new code, no unwrap/expect, no manual match where combinators would be clearer, ownership model is correct. The let-else guard is idiomatic Rust 2021. The filter+into_iter chain in destroy loop is clean.
